execution_rules: No invocation until separate root clearance.
Capture compiler argv/environment/version, JSON output, stderr, before/after source and frozen-runtime hashes.
Bind actual compiler-reported test executable hash before the one serial native process.
Busy lock is no test attempt; no automatic admission loop or retry.
Any build/runtime/source drift or failure stops the attempt and requires reviewed correction.
No DSO installation, Fortran adapter change, production change, or performance claim.
priority: Previously frozen runner2 remains first at the natural lock boundary.
test_command_template: <exact test executable from retained compiler JSON>
